'''Berkley''' is a resident of [[San Fierro]] who is a rival of [[Zero]]. The two each own their shop, although their rivalry goes back to when Zero won the top prize at a science fair. The two are, in 1992, involved in a war involving remote control vehicles. Berkley, having just returned to San Fierro, launches '[[Air Raid|a full scale attack]]' on Zero's shop and transmitters. Berkley's [[Supply Lines...|delivery men and vehicles are then targeted]] by Zero's ally [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]], and then defeated in a [[New Model Army|remote control army battle]]. After losing the battle, Berkley is told to pack up his business and leave San Fierro.

The whereabouts of Berkley are unknown, although he continues his rivalry with Zero. He is informed by Zero of the [[Breaking the Bank at Caligula's|casino heist]] planned by Carl, his friend [[Wu Zi Mu|Wu Zi "Woozie" Mu]] and Woozie's organization, the [[San Fierro Triads]]. He alerts the authorities, who storm the casino just as Carl is escaping. Berkley, however, is unsuccessful, and Carl and his team arrive back at the [[Verdant Meadows]] airstrip. Carl punches Zero for what he did.

== Trivia ==
*His name may be a reference to Berkley California.
